Upload Pricelist
Import a full pricelist or update specific SKUs only
Full Pricelist Upload
Upload your entire pricelist. New parts are added, existing SKUs are updated.
Partial Update (SKU only)
Upload a small file with only the SKUs you want to update. Everything else stays unchanged.
Full Pricelist mode: Upload your complete pricelist file. New parts will be added and existing part numbers will be updated with new values.

Click or drag & drop your Excel file here

Accepts .xlsx and .xls

Expected columns: SUPPLIER · SYSTEM · PART · PART.1 (Brand) · PART NUMBER · DESCRIPTION · CAR BRAND · VEHICLE · UNIFIED YEAR · COST · TIER 1 (Price)
For partial updates: only Part Number + the columns you want to change are required.
